methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked; any method behaves like GET.

auth.notes: Bearer header required, so a plain cannot load it; callers must fetch with the header.

query.name: slide
query.parse: Number(p.get('slide')); must be Number.isInteger and > 0. Number(null) is 0 so missing -> 400. '1.0', '1e0', ' 1' all parse to 1 and are accepted; '1.5', 'abc', '0', '-1' -> 400.

responses.bodyShape: raw PNG bytes from deck-images store key quick/<jobId>/slide_<n>_variant_A.png

errors.when: jobId missing or slide not a positive integer
slide blob missing (e.g. slide number beyond the deck)

quirks: Blob key keeps the legacy '_variant_A' suffix (blobs.ts:187-189) even though variants are gone; a reimplementation reading migrated data must use this key shape.
The slide number is not checked against job.slides; existence is decided by the blob read alone.
Unlike /api/quick-status, an unknown jobId is 404 here.
The 'error' job status also yields 404 'Images not ready', even though partial images may exist in the store.

tests.asserts: 200 + content-type image/png; 404 no job; 403 other owner; 404 pending; 404 missing blob; 400 no jobId. cache-control and error strings not asserted.

callers.who: none in Slide-Creator src/ or Auxi_Connector
callers.expects: External API users; URLs come from /api/quick-status.

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:519-546. 200 image/png with cache-control documented in description. Discrepancies: 400/403/404 responses undocumented; jobId documented as uuid but not validated.

planSection65: Row says `image/png`. Accurate; add cache-control 'private, max-age=3600'.
